cases.title: Merged dragon scales prevent an ordinary takeoff attempt
cases.mission: Merge ordinary gray dragon scales into the matching controlled dragon form, then issue one ordinary T while no other armor/accessories are worn.
cases.reproducibility: One independent unchanged input-only C replay exited0 and was byte-identical to the frozen recording. Original command/stdout/stderr/exit and exact hashes are retained; current qualification is JS-only and did not rerun C.
cases.sourceTrace: C preserves the merged armor in global uskin and dotakeoff checks it when no ordinary armor/accessories remain. JS controlled merge writes state.uskin while dotakeoff reads state.u.uskin, choosing the generic no-armor line. The observed first differing character is C T versus JS N at the single final T. This source representation disagreement does not assert hidden runtime introspection; both comparisons independently reproduce the guard output.
